key_terms.لِلشَّوَى: The scalp or top of the head

ai.seo_question: What does the Dabbabah do to the disbelievers in Hell according to Surah An-Naml?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'ash-wa' (scalps) specifically denotes the hair-bearing skin of the head, emphasizing the precision of the punishment inflicted by the Dabbah. This verse is often linked to the eschatological sign of the Dabbah emerging from the earth, serving as a divine marker for the disbelievers. The stripping of the scalp symbolizes the removal of their outward piety and the exposure of their inner falsehood.
